paper_title: Search for light scalar Dark Matter candidate with AURIGA detector
notes: AURIGA resonant-mass detector searches for scalar moduli DM. The signal strain scales as (d_me + d_e), so the limit applies equally to the electromagnetic gauge modulus coupling d_e (ScalarPhoton) and the electron-mass modulus coupling d_me (ScalarElectron); the abstract and Fig.5 present d_e. Upper limit ~1e-5 at 95% C.L. across sensitive band f=[850,950] Hz (m_phi ~3.5-3.9e-12 eV, central 3.6e-12 eV). Values read from text as approximate flat bound ~1e-5; exact per-frequency curve is in Fig.5 (not tabulated).
